business_problem: Amadeus needed a faster, more intelligent way to investigate recurring IT issues across vast volumes of system logs from millions of daily transactions.
solution_summary: Amadeus needed a faster, more intelligent way to investigate recurring IT issues across vast volumes of system logs from millions of daily transactions. Using MongoDB Atlas Search, Vector Search, and OpenAI, Amadeus built a smart incident investigation tool that matches issues to historical context across unstructured data. Amadeus improves incident investigation with MongoDB Atlas and OpenAI The Challenge Amadeus needed a faster, more intelligent way to investigate recurring IT issues across vast volumes of system logs from millions of daily transactions. Our Solution Using MongoDB Atlas Search, Vector Search, and OpenAI, Amadeus built a smart incident investigation tool that matches issues to historical context across unstructured data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Amadeus's workload.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Provides integrated full-text and faceted search across Amadeus's application data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
solution_components.role: Indexes and retrieves vector embeddings for semantic search and generative-AI workflows.

solution_components.name: OpenAI
solution_components.role: Supplies AI models used to interpret text and create richer retrieval workflows.

data_flow: Documents, logs, or product records are stored in MongoDB Atlas, embedded or indexed for MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, and queried by Amadeus's application workflows to return relevant results in real time.
metrics: Essentially serving as the booking platform for these organizations, it serves 170 airlines and helps support more than two billion passengers each year.
Amadeus records one million transactions per second and employs 18,000 people of 150 different nationalities.
Additionally, it saw a turnover of more than €5 billion in 2024.
architecture_clues: Vector search is part of the retrieval layer for AI and semantic search workloads.
